in_marathi.name: Aparajitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aparajitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'apara' meaning 'beyond' and 'jitha' meaning 'victorious' or 'invincible'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga, who is revered for her strength and power.
